entities.name: Elvar Friðriksson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Elvar Már Friðriksson is an Icelandic professional basketball player for Anwil Włocławek of the Polish Basketball League (PLK). He is also a member of the Icelandic national basketball team. He has twice been named to the Icelandic Úrvalsdeild Domestic All-First team as a member of Njarðvík. In 2020, he won the Swedish championship with Borås Basket. In 2021, he was named the 
Lithuanian Basketball League MVP after leading the league in assists. He was named the Icelandic Male Basketball Player of the Year three times in a row from 2021 to 2023.
